Interface FluentR2dbcOperations

All Superinterfaces:
ReactiveDeleteOperation, ReactiveInsertOperation, ReactiveSelectOperation, ReactiveUpdateOperation, ReactiveUpsertOperation
All Known Subinterfaces:
R2dbcEntityOperations
All Known Implementing Classes:
R2dbcEntityTemplate
public interface FluentR2dbcOperations extends ReactiveSelectOperation, ReactiveInsertOperation, ReactiveUpdateOperation, ReactiveUpsertOperation, ReactiveDeleteOperation
精简的接口，提供对流畅式 API 的访问，该 API 定义了一组基本的响应式 R2DBC 操作。
Since:
1.1
Author:
马克·帕卢赫，克里斯托夫·施特罗布
